author: BerrySmooothie
body:
Hi guys, 

I found this post on buzzfeed, and I wanted to share it with you! 

"How much do you really love peanut butter"

Out of these 58 foods, Check off all the foods you have deliberately eaten with peanut butter.

Jelly
Apple Slices
Banana
Celery
Chocolate
Bread Slices (peanut butter sandwich)
Toasted Bread
Honey
Pancakes
Nothing (straight out of the jar)
Carrots
Chocolate Chip Cookies
Animal Crackers
Graham Crackers
Hard Pretzels
Potato Chips
Bacon
French Fries
Soft Pretzels
Piece of Cake
Brownie
English Muffin
Raisins
Saltine Crackers
Waffles
French Toast
S’mores
Donuts
Nutella
Ice Cream
Ritz Crackers
Hard Boiled Egg
Oreos
Yogurt
Apple Pie
Flour Tortillas
Coffee
Actual Peanuts
Pear Slices
Tomato Slices
Scrambled Eggs
Oatmeal
Fried Chicken
Grilled Cheese
Hot Dog
Pop Tarts
Pickles
Rice Krispies
Hamburger
Another Kind of Peanut Butter
Pizza
Strawberries
Plantain Chips
Applesauce
Instant Ramen
Mac and Cheese
Popcorn
Marshmallow Fluff

If you ticked off:

0-25: Level 1

26-40: Level 2

40-58: Level 3 

Let me know what you got! I got 18/58- Level 1 xD

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
24/58 Level 1. I don't know why anyone would try it with any meaty foods *Shudders, vomits*

I'd only try it with deserts, yogurts or maybe some fruits... ugh... Hamburgers..? *Vomits violently* Mac and Cheese..? *Vomits blood* Fried Chicken!? *Vomits a heart*

I will never look at food the same way ever again... xD
